environment: Existing staging testnet, APAC Gateway, local Chromium
comparison: previous hosted candidate; capability installation without ceremony writes and the capability committed with the wallet records; previous candidate repeated. Every arm uses the custody set that binds the Hong Kong role databases
limitations: Three new wallets per arm. Worker and Durable Object cold state is unproven.
SDK payload and placement configuration stayed fixed. Physical colocation is unproven.
Only NEAR signing was enabled. The NEAR signer worker loaded and no ECDSA signer worker loaded. Shared JavaScript and custody code can contain both protocols.
Implicit account registration and NEP-413 signing exclude funding and blockchain confirmation.
Browser timing includes automation. SDK timing and interaction timing are recorded separately.

All arms use identical Gateway D1, Gateway service-call and Console D1 instrumentation. Pending calls are reported separately. This run is not a direct comparison with earlier runs that omitted this instrumentation.
Custody Worker versions and the SDK payload stay fixed across all three arms. The nine host Worker versions change in the candidate.
Sequential baseline, candidate and control samples do not establish a latency guarantee.
Playwright request interception served the browser assets. It answers every CORS preflight locally, so no arm includes the preflight exchanges that a real browser sends.
Every stage was slower than in the run of 2026-10-10, including Gateway database reads that the role-database move did not touch. The run does not isolate the effect of the move.
The comparison combines several server optimizations. It does not isolate the latency saving of each individual commit.

limitations: Worker clocks advance at I/O. A zero span does not establish zero CPU or zero implicit storage-flush cost.
Invocation wall time can include wait_until work after the response. It is not subtracted from parent requests.
Whole-invocation CPU includes protocol and lifecycle work. It is not the isolated circuit cost.

limitations: Sums include overlapping D1 calls and are not critical-path durations.
Only calls completed when the response was generated appear in the trace.
Pending and dropped calls are recorded separately.
